messages:
From: Tom Reed <t.reed@acme-health.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-11-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Initial: offline image delivery and signed manifest

Diego —

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Per our compliance lead, we need to kick off the physical delivery window for the air-gapped image and ensure the following before we hand anything to our on-prem operators:

- a signed manifest with checksums
- operator acceptance checklist filled by Redwood (so we can map responsibilities)
- a short transfer log that SecureShip will attach during handoff

We're proposing the courier window on Nov 10 (overnight) with in-facility acceptance Nov 11 morning. Can Redwood provide the signed manifest and a pre-filled operator checklist we can review? Also, please confirm the signature format you use — our security team prefers detached signatures (CMS or simple .sig) and a short verification command for the operator.

Tom
Ops Lead, Acme Health
Attachments: none
From: diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com
To: Tom Reed <t.reed@acme-health.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com, priyom_das@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-11-03T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: offline image delivery and signed manifest

Tom —

Thanks, and yes — we can meet that cadence. Sending over the artifacts you requested for your review. Summary below:

- signed-image-v1.2.manifest (attached): JSON manifest with sha256 checksums for each image layer, build_id, model_hash, provenance metadata, and build-time UTC.
- image-signature-v1.2.sig (attached): detached Ed25519 signature of the manifest. We also include a human-readable verification command we use in our operator runbooks.
- operator-acceptance-checklist.pdf (attached): pre-filled with the recommended operator gating steps (network isolation check, secure KMS stub verification, hardware TPM presence, offline sgx/attestation omission notes).

Verification snippet we recommend (UNIX):

  # fetch public key (provided separately via your key exchange)
  ed25519_verify -m signed-image-v1.2.manifest -s image-signature-v1.2.sig -k redwood-offline-pub.pem

Notes / deviations to call out:
- We sign manifests only (not entire image blobs); operators should verify manifest checksum matches the transfer log line-by-line before flashing.
- For this delivery we recommend an operator gate step to confirm offline key handle presence (we've included guidance in the checklist).

I attached a transfer-log template that SecureShip will fill in at pickup; they provided an example last week. If this looks good, Kimberly will coordinate final acceptance criteria and an abbreviated audit artifact set for your compliance folder.

Next steps: Kimberly to confirm acceptance SLA and any redlines to the checklist; Priyom to propose a short dry-run with your lead operator prior to courier pickup.

— Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: signed-image-v1.2.manifest (text/manifest), image-signature-v1.2.sig (application/pgp-signature), operator-acceptance-checklist.pdf (application/pdf), transfer-log-20261103.csv (text/csv)
From: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com
To: Tom Reed <t.reed@acme-health.com>, diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-11-03T13:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: offline image delivery and signed manifest — acceptance criteria and a couple of edits

Tom, Diego —

Thanks for the artifacts. Quick review notes (high level):

1) Manifest: Good. We asked for an additional field: operator_pin_policy (short string) so site ops can confirm local activation policy. Please add a one-line policy describing whether pin is required during flash.

2) Checklist: We trimmed a step that assumes TPM attestation is present (some customers in that region don't have TPM on all nodes). Instead, we added an alternate operator verification path (manual serial number mapping + hash check).

3) Signatures: The detached Ed25519 is fine. Tom — can you confirm your side has the public key we've shared? If you need a PKCS#7/CMS envelope instead, we can produce one; note that will change the verification command.

Dry-run proposal: Nov 9, 15:00 PT — 30-minute remote session with your lead operator (we'll walk through a decode/verify step using the manifest and signature, and then run the checklist in a staging VM). Please confirm.

If Tom confirms the public key and the dry-run slot, we'll lock final transfer-watch instructions to SecureShip and email the courier manifest to ops-team@acme-health.com.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Product Security Operations, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
